question: #11916 at 3a71be59 against 2148c7b0: did anything visual move, and what does each trigger's aria-describedby name, with which accessible description?

stories.default: core-tooltip--default: a Button wrapped in Tooltip ("Hover me")
stories.checkbox: core-checkboxinput--disabled-with-message: a disabled CheckboxInput ("Accept terms") with disabledMessage "Terms are managed by your administrator"

method.cases: hover (1280): the pointer enters from 300 px to the right in 3 steps; tap (390): a touchscreen tap at the target's center; a second show follows a first show and its close; close: the pointer moves to the corner, or a tap lands on empty page, then 900 ms
method.frames: rest: before the gesture; first: the first screencast frame whose pixels inside the tooltip's resting box (inset 3 px) differ from the frame before the gesture; resting: the end of a 1.6 s watch; closed: 900 ms after the close
method.ax: the trigger is the story root's one element with aria-describedby; each id's target element; the accessible description from the Chromium accessibility tree (CDP Accessibility.getPartialAXTree)
method.stages: rest: before any show; closedAfterFirst: after a first show closed (second-show cases); shown: at the end of the watch; closed: after the close
